title: Total internal reflection determination
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly determine whether total internal reflection occurs at side BC.

title: Final sine value
description: Essential Criteria: Student must provide the correct numerical value for sin(r') = (2√2 - √3)/4.

title: Snell's law application at D
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply Snell's law correctly at the first refraction point D with i=30°.

title: Geometry at point E
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly analyze the geometry to find the angle of incidence at point E on side BC.

title: Snell's law application at F
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply Snell's law correctly at the final refraction point F on side AC.

title: Angle relationship derivation
description: Important Criteria: Student must derive the relationship between the exiting ray and initial ray angles.

title: Critical angle comparison
description: Optional Criteria: Student may explicitly calculate and compare the critical angle with the incidence angle at E.

title: Sign error in geometry
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly calculates the angle of incidence at point E using wrong geometric relationships.

title: Snell's law inversion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly inverts Snell's law (e.g., uses n sin r = sin i instead of sin i = n sin r).
